facts: Parties: Vantage Foods Ltd (Buyer), Merrion Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Ingleby Bioscience plc.
This Agreement is dated 18 July 2026; Closing is scheduled for 22 October 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.2 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 15% of the Purchase Price, being $15,600,000. The Purchase Price is $130,000,000 (see Section 2.1).

Section 9.4 (De Minimis and Basket): the Seller shall not be liable unless the aggregate of all claims exceeds $1,300,000 (1.0% of the Purchase Price), in which case the Seller shall be liable only for the excess over that amount.
Section 12.1: the Seller shall not compete with the business for 4 years after Closing.

Section 10.1 (Survival): the General Warranties survive Closing for 18 months; the Fundamental Warranties (title, capacity, tax) survive for 72 months. Claims must be notified in writing before expiry.
Clause 18: the Founder shall not compete with the business for 18 months after termination of employment.

Disclosure against Warranty 8.2 (IP): the Company's core platform software was developed in 2023 by an independent contractor, Penrith Technologies Ltd. No written assignment of intellectual property was entered into.
